name: Ayashi Nana
source: [url=/c65162]Ryou's[/url] classmate and an ordinary girl with average grades. She has been in love with Ryou ever since the first year of high school, but her heart got broken as she found out he was dating [url=/c65163]Chitose[/url]. After Chitose' death however, she started comforting him through sex.
